beats.note: EPSILON CYGNI, 3089 AD. ALL LIFE ON THE EXOPLANET LYRA HAS BEEN OBLITERATED...
...APART FROM THE HOLOSONIC VESSEL QNTM CNTRL...
FOUR-DIMENSIONAL MANIFOLD ENABLED, QNTM CNTRL TRAVERSES THE EXPANSE OF CYGNUS A...
beats.why: Paul, 25 October: the reader drags to fold the manifold's slabs together; when the creases meet the ship slingshots through (to build)

beats.note: OUR FALLEN SHIP IS INTERCEPTED BY A SCOUT PATROL FROM AN ANCIENT TRIBE.
THEIR PLUNDER OF QNTM CTRL'S HOLD RETRIEVES URANIUM AND THE INVALUABLE CRYPTID, STILL DEEP IN HYPERSLEEP.
IN METABOLIC STASIS, THE PSYCHEDELIC VIBRATIONS OF THEIR BONFIRE RITUAL...
beats.why: Paul, 25 October: the reader taps in time with the music; on-beat taps flare the fire and the pod; about eight good hits trigger the decode (to build)

beats.note: ...WOULD SOON TRIGGER OBTRAN TO BEGIN ITS DECODE PROTOCOL.

helix.note: Paul, 25 October: the twisting DNA strands built precisely in 3D for the final scene. from/to are [yaw, pitch, distance] in the world's frame (Marble units): near the ends of the world's own helix, measured from its mint splats (it arcs round the viewer about 2 units out), lowered about 9 and 5 degrees so the 3D one crosses the middle of the view; the 3D one runs along the chord between them, so it passes a little nearer. radius from the spread of those splats. fadeHue: [hue from, hue to, least brightness, fade] for the world's own helix splats.
